name: Impulsion
source:
Join Victoria and Walter, two officers trying to save the city of Luminox from the grasp of Impulsion - a gang of criminals seeking to bring an end to the steam revolution.

[From [url=https://brandon-jones-cgd.itch.io/final-major-project-impulsion] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入维多利亚和沃尔特这两名警官的行列，试图将鲁米诺克斯市从冲动（一群试图结束蒸汽革命的犯罪团伙）手中拯救出来。

[来自[url=https://brandon-jones-cgd.itch.io/final-major-project-impulsion] itch.io[/url]]
